notes.source: The services sheet's reorder announcement, in both clients (#806): the sentence a screen reader hears after a row moves. It was an inline template literal in `use-services-order.ts`; the app draws the same sheet, so the sentence moved into one source rather than being retyped into Kotlin (ADR-0098).
notes.placeholders: `{label}` is the row, `{position}` is its one-based slot and `{total}` is the number of rows. Each client substitutes them itself, so the punctuation stays in one place.
notes.gate: `npm run check:copy` fails a stale generated output, and `npm run check:parity` fails a key `frontend/ui/navbar/use-services-order.ts` does not render.
